pkgmetadata.longdescription: DMD is the reference compiler for the D programming language. This package follows Arch Linux extra/dmd: the compiler is built from the dlang/dmd tag, and the Phobos standard library plus Druntime live in dev-libs/libphobos. The host compiler is the upstream prebuilt dmd of the same release, which is only unpacked in the build directory and never installed.
